annotations.title: Quote Link status and the customer's answer

description:
See where a Quote Link stands: its status, how often the customer page was opened, and every answer the customer gave (approve, decline or changes; the option and add-ons picked, the amount, the name they typed, the time, and which version of the quote it answered, with any message), plus every version of the quote, the date it is valid until, and the customer_url. Read-only. Status is one of open, approved, declined, changes_requested, expired, cancelled or disabled.

Needs the quote's manage_token (returned when the quote was made, or the code after # in the private link https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#…; the whole private link is accepted too). An answer names its option by index from 0; option_name and addon_names give the names from the version that was answered. The manage_token and the private link are the user's private key to the quote.

manage_token.description: The quote's private manage token: the long code after # in the private link (https://www.workeey.com/q/m/#<token>), returned as manage_token when the quote is created. The whole private link is accepted too. Required, unless your MCP client already sends it as an Authorization: Bearer header.
